# Hooks — Evidence

<!-- Generated by `tyto-docs-engine build-evidence`. Do not edit. -->

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.4201f24c"></a>**1. The frontend/src/hooks unit's index.ts re-exports the five hooks useAuth, useUpload, useJobStatus, useCalendars, and useWorkflowGuard, along with the WorkflowPage type.**
  [`index.ts:4-9`](../index.ts#L4-L9)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.113c0f9b"></a>**2. useAuth returns authentication state (isAuthenticated, user, isLoading, error) and actions (login, logout, setError) sourced from the auth store.**
  [`useAuth.ts:15-46`](../useAuth.ts#L15-L46)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.ebfd4865"></a>**3. useAuth's login action redirects the browser to the Google OAuth login URL built by authService.getLoginUrl, defaulting to the current page path when no return URL is provided.**
  [`useAuth.ts:32-35`](../useAuth.ts#L32-L35)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.435fd042"></a>**4. useJobStatus returns the stored job status from the event store, mapping the store's 'complete' value to 'completed' for backward compatibility, and always reports isPolling as false.**
  [`useJobStatus.ts:28-50`](../useJobStatus.ts#L28-L50)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.7014decc"></a>**5. useUpload's upload action uploads a PDF through uploadService.uploadPdf with progress tracking, stores the returned job ID, and on completion stores the parsed events and job status and updates semester dates in the config store.**
  [`useUpload.ts:40-78`](../useUpload.ts#L40-L78)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.b9e53794"></a>**6. useCalendars' fetchCalendars loads all calendars for the authenticated user through calendarService.listCalendars and updates local state, setting an error message on failure.**
  [`useCalendars.ts:30-43`](../useCalendars.ts#L30-L43)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.18de8ea5"></a>**7. useCalendars' createCalendar creates a calendar through calendarService.createCalendar and appends the created calendar to the local list, re-throwing any error after recording it.**
  [`useCalendars.ts:51-67`](../useCalendars.ts#L51-L67)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.d56cd0d3"></a>**8. useAuth checks the authentication status once on mount, guarded by a hasChecked ref so the check runs only a single time.**
  [`useAuth.ts:20-26`](../useAuth.ts#L20-L26)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.cb57a817"></a>**9. useCalendars returns the calendar list, loading state, error, and the fetchCalendars and createCalendar actions for managing Google Calendar operations.**
  [`useCalendars.ts:22-76`](../useCalendars.ts#L22-L76)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.2e418d97"></a>**10. useUpload returns upload, progress, isUploading, error, and reset for managing PDF file uploads.**
  [`useUpload.ts:25-96`](../useUpload.ts#L25-L96)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.189679a3"></a>**11. useUpload's reset action clears the progress, isUploading, and error state.**
  [`useUpload.ts:83-87`](../useUpload.ts#L83-L87)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.dee1cbf0"></a>**12. useWorkflowGuard guards a workflow page and redirects to another page when the page's requirements are not met, waiting for store hydration before evaluating them.**
  [`useWorkflowGuard.ts:35-96`](../useWorkflowGuard.ts#L35-L96)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.c7935c6d"></a>**13. useWorkflowGuard requires events to be loaded for the preview page, and events plus at least one selected event for the customize and generate pages.**
  [`useWorkflowGuard.ts:66-75`](../useWorkflowGuard.ts#L66-L75)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-hooks.10b5cdd4"></a>**14. useWorkflowGuard redirects to /upload from preview, /preview from customize, and /customize from generate when requirements are not met.**
  [`useWorkflowGuard.ts:78-82`](../useWorkflowGuard.ts#L78-L82)
